verdict.rationale: A state business-registry portal could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions. The only analysis features are the open-data portal's manual exploration canvas (sort, filter, shape) and dataset analysis, which run on the Socrata host platform and are not AI-generated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
